title: Form and unit consistency rules
summary: Lint rules comparing a form unit with its .dfm and .dpr: fields vs objects, form resource, inherited handlers, self-free, auto-created forms
intro: Read this when a form loads with a nil field, raises EResNotFound, loses an ancestor's event handler or ends up with two instances: these rules read the .pas, its sibling .dfm and the .dpr together and say which file to change.
